2609.03937.title: RATL: Learning from Retrieved Residuals for Robust Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
2609.03937.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) complements parametric models with retrieved external evidence. The same idea is attractive for continuous-output regression, but directly reusing retrieved target values is often not robust when samples differ in output level, numerical scale, or local dynamics. Moreover, conventional forecasting pipelines generally use residuals for model optimization and error diagnosis, but do not retain individual historical residual examples as memory that can be accessed at inference time.For multivariate time-series forecasting, we propose RATL, a plug-in residual-retrieval and feedback-correction method. RATL freezes a base forecaster to construct retrieval keys and turns its historical forecast residuals into a train-only memory specific to that base model. At inference time, RATL retrieves residual trajectories from similar historical contexts subject to causal availability constraints, then uses a set-aware router operating over forecast blocks and variables to select and combine these trajectories. Experiments show that historical residuals matched to the current context contain reusable forecasting information and that RATL improves frozen base forecasters in most experimental settings. Ablations further show that learned routing strengthens raw residual feedback, while validation-based correction-strength selection limits residual over-injection.On real-world benchmarks, we use iTransformer as the primary frozen base forecaster, compare against multiple strong forecasting baselines, and test transferability across backbones. The results show that RATL can further improve base-forecaster performance in most settings.Overall, RATL shifts the retrieved object from historical target values to base-model-specific historical forecast errors, providing a plug-in, residual-memory-based paradigm for learned feedback correction in continuous-output forecasting.
2609.03937.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）通過檢索外部證據來補充參數模型。這一想法對於連續輸出回歸來說也很有吸引力，但在樣本在輸出水平、數值尺度或局部動態上有所不同時，直接重用檢索到的目標值往往不夠穩健。此外，傳統的預測流程通常使用殘差進行模型優化和錯誤診斷，但不會將個別歷史殘差示例保留為可以在推理時訪問的記憶。對於多變量時間序列預測，我們提出了RATL，一種插件式殘差檢索和反饋修正方法。RATL 凍結一個基礎預測器以構建檢索鍵，並將其歷史預測殘差轉化為僅限於該基礎模型的訓練記憶。在推理時，RATL 從類似的歷史上下文中檢索殘差軌跡，受因果可用性約束的限制，然後使用一個在預測塊和變量上運作的集aware路由器來選擇和組合這些軌跡。實驗顯示，與當前上下文匹配的歷史殘差包含可重用的預測信息，並且RATL在大多數實驗設置中改善了凍結的基礎預測器。消融實驗進一步顯示，學習的路由增強了原始殘差反饋，而基於驗證的修正強度選擇則限制了殘差的過度注入。在現實世界的基準測試中，我們使用iTransformer作為主要的凍結基礎預測器，與多個強大的預測基準進行比較，並測試在不同骨幹之間的可轉移性。結果顯示，RATL可以在大多數設置中進一步改善基礎預測器的性能。總體而言，RATL將檢索對象從歷史目標值轉變為基礎模型特定的歷史預測錯誤，為連續輸出預測中的學習反饋修正提供了一種插件式的基於殘差記憶的範式。
